evidence: PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest.java:413 has the comment '// Succesful event - password login'. The earlier comment in the same test (around line 389) spells it 'Successful'. It is a typo in a comment only and has no functional effect.

PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest.java:290-296 and 311-317 call assertThat(driver.findElement(//form[@id='webauth']), nullValue()) inside try/catch (Exception). findElement never returns null: it either throws NoSuchElementException or returns an element. If the element exists, the AssertionError (an Error, not an Exception) still propagates, so the check does not silently pass in that case. But catch (Exception) also swallows unrelated WebDriver exceptions (stale session, timeouts) as 'expected', and the assertion reads misleadingly. The codebase already uses the suggested idiom: before this PR, PasskeysOrganizationAuthenticationTest used Assert.assertThrows(NoSuchElementException.class, () -> driver.findElement(...)). Test-quality improvement, not a correctness bug.

UsernameForm.java:47 calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments. The only declaration is UsernamePasswordForm.java:160 `protected boolean isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)`, and grep finds no no-arg overload anywhere in services. This is a compile error. HEAD commit 3214b188 changed the signature but did not update this caller. Fix: pass context.getUser().

UsernamePasswordForm.java:160-162 returns webauthnAuth != null && isPasskeysEnabled() && user != null. Both callers, authenticate() at :115 and challenge() at :137, pass context.getUser(), which is null on the initial login page. So webauthnAuth.fillContextForm() (WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator) is never called there and the conditional UI attributes and the webauth form are not rendered. Before the PR, authenticate() called fillContextForm in the user==null branch and challenge() did so when context.getUser()==null, so this is a regression. It also breaks the PR's own tests, which assert //form[@id='webauth'] is present on the initial login (PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest.java:196, 238) and expect automatic passkey login on the first openLoginForm (PasskeysUsernameFormTest, PasskeysOrganizationAuthenticationTest). The user != null clause should be removed.

PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest.java:35 imports org.keycloak.models.credential.PasswordCredentialModel, and grep finds no other reference to it in the file. The import is unused, but it does not break compilation. No checkstyle UnusedImports rule was found in the repo, so this is cleanup only.

Duplicate of issue 1. PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest.java:290-296 and 311-317 use findElement plus assertThat(nullValue()) inside catch (Exception). findElement throws rather than returning null, so the nullValue matcher is meaningless and the broad catch can hide unrelated WebDriver failures. Use Assert.assertThrows(NoSuchElementException.class, ...), as the pre-PR PasskeysOrganizationAuthenticationTest did, or findElements(...).isEmpty().

WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.java:65 declares protected boolean shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators(AuthenticationFlowContext), which overrides WebAuthnAuthenticator.java:128. WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator extends WebAuthnPasswordlessAuthenticator, which extends WebAuthnAuthenticator. It has no @Override annotation. The override works without it, but adding it guards against a silent non-override if the signature ever changes.
